description: Use this when the user asks about a workout or program already saved to Phorme in this conversation, for example to get its Phorme link again. It returns the title and open link for training owned by the connected Phorme account and changes nothing. It needs the training_id from that save. It cannot list, search, edit or delete training.

training_id.description: The training_id returned by save_workout_to_phorme or save_program_to_phorme.

training_kind.description: Whether the saved item is a workout or a program.

name: get_saved_training

open_url.description: Link that opens the saved training in Phorme.

title: Get saved Phorme training
